tool_schemas.name: search_wikipedia
tool_schemas.description: Searches our indexed Wikipedia titles/keywords in the requested language and returns a page of matching articles sorted by the selected mode, with up to `limit` results and an opaque `cursor` you can pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query`/`language_code` are missing, `limit` is outside 1–50, `sort`/`status` is not one of the allowed values, or `cursor` is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to search and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded. Returns NOT_FOUND only when the requested `language_code` is unsupported by the index; otherwise an empty result set is returned when there are no matches.

query.description: Search query string to match against Wikipedia titles/keywords.

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code to search within (e.g., 'en').

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

sort.description: Sort mode for results (relevance based on match vs popularity score).

status.description: Filter search index entries by status.

tool_schemas.name: get_article
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the full content for a Wikipedia article as a cached snapshot, resolved by `article_id` (preferred) or by (`title`/`page_id` + `language_code`), and returns content in `html`, `text`, or `both`; when `force_refresh=true` we bypass cache and refetch the latest snapshot before returning it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are missing/ambiguous, `article_id` does not match the expected pattern, `format` is invalid, or `language_code` is missing when using `title`/`page_id`; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access article content and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when no article exists for the resolved key (or the snapshot id is unknown) and CONFLICT when a refresh is requested but the article is currently locked for cache invalidation/rebuild.

article_id.description: Internal article snapshot id (ULID) to fetch.

title.description: Wikipedia article title to fetch (used if article_id is not provided).

page_id.description: Wikipedia page id to fetch (used if article_id/title is not provided).

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code for the article (required when using title or page_id).

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and refetch the latest article snapshot.

tool_schemas.name: get_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached lead summary for an article resolved by `article_id` or by (`title`/`page_id` + `language_code`); when `force_refresh=true` we bypass cache and refetch the latest summary before returning it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are missing/ambiguous, `article_id` does not match the expected pattern, or `language_code` is missing when using `title`/`page_id`; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access summaries and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when the article (or snapshot id) cannot be resolved and CONFLICT when a refresh is requested but the summary is locked due to an in-progress cache invalidation/rebuild.

article_id.description: Internal article snapshot id (ULID) to fetch the summary for.

title.description: Wikipedia article title to fetch summary for (used if article_id is not provided).

page_id.description: Wikipedia page id to fetch summary for (used if article_id/title is not provided).

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code for the article (required when using title or page_id).

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cache and refetch the latest summary.

tool_schemas.name: get_related_topics
tool_schemas.description: Computes and returns related topics for an article (resolved by `article_id` or by (`title`/`page_id` + `language_code`)) using link edges, category edges, or both, filtered by `status` and `min_weight`, and paged with up to `limit` items plus an opaque `cursor` for the next page; when `force_refresh=true` we rebuild relatedness from the latest data before returning results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are missing/ambiguous, `limit` is outside 1–50, `edge_type`/`status` is invalid, `cursor` is malformed, `min_weight` is not a number, `article_id` pattern is invalid, or `language_code` is missing when using `title`/`page_id`; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot access related-topic data and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND when the base article cannot be resolved and CONFLICT when a refresh is requested but related-topic graph calculation is already in progress for that article.

article_id.description: Internal article snapshot id (ULID) to find related topics for.

title.description: Wikipedia article title to find related topics for (used if article_id is not provided).

page_id.description: Wikipedia page id to find related topics for (used if article_id/title is not provided).

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code for the article (required when using title or page_id).

limit.description: Maximum number of related topics to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of related topics.

edge_type.description: Which relationship type(s) to use when computing related topics.

min_weight.description: Minimum edge weight threshold to include a related topic.

force_refresh.description: Whether to bypass cached graph calculations and rebuild from the latest data.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client identity for the presented credential, including client id, display name, status, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for the active window. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is revoked.

api_key.description: API key credential presented by the caller (sent on every request to authenticate and apply rate limits).

tool_schemas.name: list_articles
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached article snapshots filtered by language, status, and optional title/page_id match, returning a page of results with an opaque cursor for pagination. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/revoked, and VALIDATION_ERROR if filters, limit, or cursor are malformed.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code to filter within (e.g., 'en').

title_prefix.description: Filter by article title prefix (case-insensitive, matches normalized titles).

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_article_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Fetches one cached article snapshot row by internal `article_id` and returns metadata plus cached content fields. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid; returns NOT_FOUND if the article does not exist; and returns FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/revoked.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

article_id.description: Internal article snapshot id (ULID) to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_article
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new cached article snapshot row or updates an existing one for cache maintenance and refresh workflows. Enforces valid status transitions and refuses writes that would violate lifecycle rules. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/revoked, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed fields, and CONFLICT when a requested status transition is not allowed.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

article_id.description: Internal article snapshot id (ULID). If provided and found, updates that row; if not found, creates it. If omitted, a new id is generated.

page_id.description: Wikipedia page id for the article.

normalized_title.description: Normalized title used for stable lookup and de-duplication.

wikipedia_url.description: Canonical Wikipedia URL for the article.

extract_html.description: Cached full article extract in HTML.

extract_text.description: Cached full article extract as plain text.

content_revision_id.description: Wikipedia revision id corresponding to the cached content when available.

content_fetched_at.description: Timestamp when full content was last fetched/refreshed.

summary_fetched_at.description: Timestamp when summary was last fetched/refreshed.

status.description: Lifecycle status to set; transition must be allowed from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_search_index_entry
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a search index entry used by `search_wikipedia`, enforcing foreign key integrity to `articles` and valid lifecycle status transitions. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/revoked, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed fields, NOT_FOUND if `article_id` does not exist, and CONFLICT when a requested status transition is not allowed.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

id.description: Internal search index entry id (ULID). If provided and found, updates that row; if not found, creates it. If omitted, a new id is generated.

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code for the index entry (e.g., 'en').

article_id.description: Referenced article snapshot id; must exist.

normalized_title.description: Normalized title used for stable matching.

keywords.description: Keywords/tokens used to match search queries.

popularity_score.description: Popularity score used for sorting and ranking.

status.description: Lifecycle status to set; transition must be allowed from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: upsert_article_graph_edge
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a relatedness graph edge between two articles for `get_related_topics`, enforcing foreign key integrity and valid lifecycle status transitions. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the credential is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/revoked, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed fields, NOT_FOUND if either referenced article id does not exist, and CONFLICT when a requested status transition is not allowed.

api_key.description: API key credential used to authenticate the caller.

id.description: Internal graph edge id (ULID). If provided and found, updates that row; if not found, creates it. If omitted, a new id is generated.

language_code.description: Wikipedia language code for the edge (e.g., 'en').

from_article_id.description: Source article snapshot id; must exist.

to_article_id.description: Target article snapshot id; must exist and must not equal from_article_id.

edge_type.description: Type of relation represented by this edge.

weight.description: Non-negative weight used in relatedness ranking.

status.description: Lifecycle status to set; transition must be allowed from the current status.

metadata.name: Wikipedia Information Server
metadata.description: This backend powers a Wikipedia information API that lets clients search Wikipedia, fetch full articles, fetch summaries, and discover related topics. It stores cached article snapshots, a searchable index of titles/keywords, and per-request logs to support rate limiting, analytics, and cache invali
